description: This file declares functions and includes relevant headers for managing HTTP chunked data handling in the project, such as appending memory, buffers, and files to HTTP requests, as well as decoding and transferring chunk data.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_mem
methods.description: Copies a specified amount of memory into the HTTP chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends a buffer to the HTTP chunk, possibly resetting the buffer.

methods.name: http_chunk_decode_append_mem
methods.description: Decodes and appends memory data to the request.

methods.name: http_chunk_decode_append_buffer
methods.description: Decodes and appends buffer data to the request.

methods.name: http_chunk_transfer_cqlen
methods.description: Transfers a specific length of chunk data from source to request.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_fd
methods.description: Appends the contents of a file descriptor to the request.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_ref
methods.description: Appends file reference data to the request.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_fd_range
methods.description: Appends a range of data from a file descriptor.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_ref_range
methods.description: Appends a range of data from a file reference.

methods.name: http_chunk_close
methods.description: Closes the HTTP chunk for the current request.
